topics.question_text: How should your community's law enforcement relate to federal immigration enforcement?

stances.text: Refuse all ICE detainers; prohibit local employees from sharing immigration status information with federal agencies
Comply with ICE detainers only when they are ordered by a court
Follow federal law as required but do not use local resources for proactive immigration enforcement
Honor ICE detainers and share information proactively when federal agencies request it
Direct local police to actively assist with immigration enforcement and support federal detention operations
